note_on_method: Each venue page rests on one Town of Mount Pleasant page, the Recreation Department's pickleball page, which lists every venue under an Indoor or Outdoor heading with a count, a two-line address and a paragraph of rules, plus the US Census address geocoder for the county and the postcode. Park West is two Town entries at one address, published as one venue. Where the Town is silent, these pages record the silence.

slots.description:
One indoor pickleball court at the Town's Senior Center on Von Kolnitz Road, listed on the Town's pickleball page as "Mount Pleasant Senior Center 50+ / 1 Court". The "50+" is not part of the building's name. It is the condition of entry, and the Town spells it out beneath: "Drop-in play is for anyone 50 years and older and is free for members of the Senior Center."

The paragraph that follows is unusually complete for a single court. Non-members "may join in for a guest fee of $5 for Mt. Pleasant residents and $10 for those residing outside of Mt. Pleasant", and "Nets, balls, and paddles are provided". It is the one venue in Mount Pleasant where you can arrive with nothing in your hands. The Town gives a phone number for the centre, 843-856-2166.
slots.getting_there:
840 Von Kolnitz Road, Mount Pleasant, SC 29464, as the Town prints it. The US Census address geocoder matched the address at house-number level, placed it in Charleston County and in the incorporated place Mount Pleasant town, and the postcodes agree.

The Town publishes nothing about parking, transit or restrooms at the Senior Center, and nothing about the building's own opening hours. The times given here are pickleball sessions. Non-members should expect to pay the guest fee on arrival.
slots.what_to_expect:
A drop-in for players 50 and older, on one court, three afternoons a week: Tuesday and Thursday 3:00 to 4:50 pm and Friday 3:00 to 5:50 pm, with "101 Lessons with Al" on Fridays from 1:00 to 2:50 pm beforehand.

Equipment is the thing to notice. Everywhere else in Mount Pleasant the Town lends a net and asks you to bring paddles and balls. Here it provides all three.

With one court there is no rotation to speak of, and the Town says nothing about how many people come. Surface is not stated.

faqs.a: Anyone 50 years and older, in the Town's words. It is the one Mount Pleasant venue with an age condition.
For members of the Senior Center, yes. Non-members pay a guest fee of $5 if they live in Mount Pleasant and $10 if they do not.

faqs.q: Do I need to bring anything?
faqs.a: No. "Nets, balls, and paddles are provided", which the Town states at no other Mount Pleasant venue.

slots.description:
Ten pickleball courts at one address in the Park West complex: six in the Park West Gym and four lit courts on the Park West Tennis Courts. The Town lists them as two entries, one under Indoor and one under Outdoor, both at 1251 Park West Boulevard, and they publish here as one venue.

The six is stated twice: in the Indoor entry, and in the Town's notice for the Al Bradshaw-Whittemore Pickleball Classic held here in April 2026, which gives the location as "Park West Gym / 6 Indoor Courts". The four outside are tennis courts first, in name and in the Town's own warning: "Our MPRD Tennis Pros do have court priority for lessons!" A Program Building stands "directly beside the courts" and is where the nets are kept.
slots.getting_there:
1251 Park West Boulevard, Mount Pleasant, SC 29466, the address the Town prints under both entries. The US Census geocoder matched it at house-number level, in Charleston County and in the incorporated place Mount Pleasant town.

The Town publishes nothing about parking, transit or restrooms here. It does say where to go once you arrive: sign in at the gym, where "All players MUST sign in", and collect a net from the Program Building beside the outdoor courts, Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
slots.what_to_expect:
Two different days at one address. Indoors, six courts on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, 8:00 am to 12:00 pm, and on eight listed Sunday mornings from September 13 to November 15, 2026. "Drop-in play is free", nets are provided for players to set up, and only water is allowed in the gym. Bring your own balls and paddles.

Outdoors, four lit tennis courts, "first come first served and free". Nets come from the Program Building on weekdays until 5:00 p.m., and "You must provide your own net if playing outside of business hours." The Town's tennis pros have priority for lessons, and Monday afternoons from 3:30 to 6:30 pm are closed to pickleball from August 24 to December 7, 2026. Surface is not stated.

faqs.a: The four outdoor tennis courts are; the Town lists them as lighted. The six gym courts are indoors and the Town says nothing about lighting there.

faqs.q: How do I join the evening group?
faqs.a: Reserve a spot on the TeamReach app with the code 29466. The group meets on the tennis courts Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, 6:00 to 8:00 pm.

slots.description:
Four indoor pickleball courts in the gym at the Town's Municipal Complex on Ann Edwards Lane, listed on the Town's pickleball page as "The Deb Gym at Town Hall / 4 Courts" under its Indoor heading.

The Town's paragraph is the same one it prints for Park West Gym: "Drop-in play is free. All players MUST sign in. Only water allowed inside the gym. NO OTHER FOOD OR DRINK ALLOWED." Nets are provided for players to set up; balls and paddles are yours to bring.

The season is what is particular to this gym. The Town states that during volleyball season, Friday September 18 through Saturday October 31, all pickleball open gyms will only be played on two pickleball courts. Four is the stated count; two is what to expect for six weeks of the autumn.
slots.getting_there:
100 Ann Edwards Lane, Mount Pleasant, SC 29464. The US Census address geocoder matched "100 ANN EDWARDS LN, MOUNT PLEASANT, SC, 29464" at house-number level, in Charleston County, in the incorporated place Mount Pleasant town.

The Town publishes nothing about parking, transit or restrooms at Town Hall. You sign in on arrival, and only water goes into the gym with you.
slots.what_to_expect:
Three weekday sessions, all free, all in daylight hours: Mondays 1:00 to 3:00 pm, Wednesdays 9:00 am to 12:00 pm and Fridays 8:00 am to 12:00 pm. Four courts is two games at once, in the weeks when all four are up.

Check the date before you go. The Town lists the days the gym is closed to pickleball: Labor Day, September 7; a Town wellness fair on Wednesday, September 16; Veterans Day, November 11; the day after Thanksgiving, November 27; and Christmas Day.

Enter at the designated time, sign in, and be ready to break the nets down a few minutes before the end. Those are the Town's instructions for its gyms. Bring balls and paddles. The Town says nothing about surface or about how busy the sessions get.

faqs.a: Four, in the Town's words "The Deb Gym at Town Hall / 4 Courts", reduced to two during volleyball season, September 18 to October 31.

faqs.q: Is it Ann or Anne Edwards Lane?
faqs.a: The Town's page uses both spellings. The venue entry, the Town's footer and the Census address file all say Ann, and that is what publishes.

slots.description:
Four outdoor pickleball courts at the Miriam Brown Community Center on Royall Avenue, listed under the Town's Outdoor heading as "Miriam Brown Community Center / 4 Courts". They are free and "first come, first served", in the Town's words, with nets lent on weekdays from the G.M. Darby Building, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and paddles and balls to bring yourself.

The rule that shapes the day is printed in capitals: "NO OPEN PICKLEBALL PLAY WHEN THE COMMUNITY CENTER IS OPEN!" The Town then defines when that is, season by season.

The Town's outdoor clinics run here under Coach Don Fickling, "a PCI Certified Pickleball Coach", assisted by Jackie Kelly, "USA Pickleball Ambassador", who together "lead Old Blue Truck Pickleball".
slots.getting_there:
118 Royall Avenue, Mount Pleasant, SC 29464, as the Town prints it, Royall with two Ls. The US Census address geocoder matched "118 ROYALL AVE, MOUNT PLEASANT, SC, 29464" at house-number level, in Charleston County and in the incorporated place Mount Pleasant town.

The Town publishes nothing about parking, transit or restrooms here. The one building it names is the G.M. Darby Building, where the nets are kept on weekdays, and it does not say how far that is from the courts.
slots.what_to_expect:
A morning venue by habit and an afternoon closure by rule. The Town's open play group meets every day of the week, Monday to Sunday, 7:00 to 11:00 am. That is the only daily session in Mount Pleasant. Four courts is two games at once.

Then the ban. From September to May there is no open pickleball on weekday afternoons and early evenings, 2:30 to 6:30 pm, or on Saturdays from 11:00 am to 3:30 pm. From June to August the weekday closure runs 11:30 am to 3:30 pm instead. The Town adds that "Times may vary to accommodate MPRD activities."

Nets come from the G.M. Darby Building on weekdays only, so a Saturday or Sunday morning means your own net. Surface is not stated.

faqs.a: Lent on weekdays from the G.M. Darby Building, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Bring your own at weekends, and bring paddles and balls always.
Not stated. The Town marks lighting at the Park West tennis courts and says nothing here, so it is recorded as unverified rather than as a no.
